effect_description_eng:
＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 level 4 or lower [DM] trait Digimon card from your trash as this Digimon's top digivolution card. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the same color as any of this Digimon's digivolution cards. If this Digimon has 6 or more colors in its digivolution cards, instead delete 1 of each of your opponent's Digimon with different colors.
[All Turns] This Digimon gets +1000 DP for each color in its digivolution cards.
xros_req:
Assembly Requirements [Assembly -7] 7 level 4 [DM] trait Digimon cards w/different names
When this would be played, by placing the specified cards from the trash under it, reduce the play cost.
